data.title: 山田杏奈 · 图书馆书架死角偷吃薯片的受惊回眸·「市川……嘘！不许告诉图书委员！」
data.description: 午休的图书室里，杏奈躲在书架间吃薯片，腮帮子还鼓着，就看见你走进过道。她穿着整齐的校服和米色开衫，一手把零食袋藏到背后，另一手赶紧把食指抵在唇边，请你替她保守这个小秘密。
data.location: 图书室高耸书架死角矮凳前
data.action: 蹲在书架间，一手藏薯片袋，另一手竖指示意安静，嘴里还含着零食。
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, action and face visible
data.promptProse: Anna Yamada pauses between library shelves with her cheeks still full of chips as her companion enters the aisle. She hides the snack bag behind her back and raises one finger to her lips. Her beige cardigan, white blouse and navy skirt remain neat beneath a high black ponytail. The medium eye-level view retains shelves on both sides; soft window light illuminates her surprised face and cardigan cuff, leaving the hidden bag partly shaded.
